description: Top-left window capture coordinates in points. `default` is the `content` region: right of the 220pt gallery sidebar (SIDEBAR_IDEAL_WIDTH) and below the 52pt native unified toolbar (verify against captures on the installed OS). `regions` adds named regions measured from the same capture; `sidebar` is x 0-220pt below the toolbar. x/y use each capture's measured pixels-per-window-point scale; right/bottom are optional insets, width/height optional extents. Per-page entries merge with `default`, and their `regions` merge per name.
